scope: Review only. No source lock, source PNG, or cloud GLB was modified.

manual_structural_constraints.two_layer_head: PASS — upper/lower head shells read in front, both profiles, and back
manual_structural_constraints.harness_continuity: PASS — visible as one front-to-back diagonal strap
manual_structural_constraints.pouch_physical_left_only: PASS — visible in front/character-left/back; absent in character-right
manual_structural_constraints.ankle_rings_and_split_wedge_feet: PASS — ring and foot landmarks are visible in every view

registered_silhouette_iou.result: FAIL — model is recognizably consistent, but not yet a sufficiently close reconstruction to freeze before destructive topology work.

topology_review.why: The current mesh is an open, fragmented surface representation. Smart decimation can submit and finish on such a GLB, but it has no reliable basis for preserving thin shells, strap boundaries, rings, and finger gaps.

reduceface_api_check.official_api_contract: SubmitReduceFaceJob accepts File3D.Type and File3D.Url; the published request schema does not document a manifold/watertight precondition.
reduceface_api_check.project_empirical_evidence: Mira v06 submitted a similarly fragmented Hunyuan GLB (2087 components / 108488 non-manifold edges) and returned DONE, but its ReduceFace output was later audited as hole-prone. Therefore API acceptance is not a topology quality gate.
reduceface_api_check.operational_hard_gate: The immutable Hunyuan mesh is a visual/bake source, not a topology-repair target. Do not use whole-character voxel/SDF reconstruction or other global surface resampling. A downstream candidate must use part-aware manual retopology or precisely bounded local edits, then pass 0 boundary edges, 0 non-manifold edges, 0 loose vertices, no self intersections, and the visual gates.

recommended_route: Keep the Hunyuan GLB immutable as the visual and bake authority; do not attempt to close all 2,360 source patches into one global surface.
Build the runtime mesh by part-aware manual retopology with explicit separation for head layers, shoulder plates, harness, pouch, ankle rings, fingers, and split toes.
When a downstream ReduceFace result has a small, fully enumerated defect set, repair only those faces and edges without moving vertices or changing bounds.
Bake/project texture and detail from the immutable Hunyuan source only after topology and four-view fit are accepted.
Audit every exported GLB after re-import before UV, rigging, medium/low LOD, or runtime promotion.
reject_conditions: any open boundary or non-manifold edge after retopology/local repair export
pouch appears in character-right profile or moves from physical-left hip
harness discontinuity, head layers fuse, ankle rings fuse/open, or split toe gap closes
any four-view silhouette remains below the agreed acceptance threshold after the retopology/local repair pass
